title: Quick protocol for protein extraction from adherent fish-derived fibroblasts
author: Joao M Moreno

steps.title: Wash cells
steps.instruction: Remove all culture media from the flask and wash the cells with ice-cold 1X PBS.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Remove the ice-cold 1X PBS and add ice-cold lysis buffer (RIPA buffer) based on the estimated cell count.

substeps.instruction: Use 1 mL of buffer for 10^7 cells (approximately a T75 flask).

steps.title: Dissociate and collect cells
steps.instruction: Dissociate the cells from the bottom of the flask and transfer them to a microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Use a cell scraper to dissociate the cells.
Resuspend the cells in the lysis buffer.
Transfer the suspension to a microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge sample
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the suspension at 13,000 x g for 20 min at 4°C.

steps.title: Recover soluble protein
steps.instruction: Separate the soluble protein from the cellular debris.

substeps.instruction: Carefully transfer the supernatant containing the soluble protein to a new tube.
